props.name: Sniper Focus

props.classMechanic_text:
SNIPER'S FOCUS

A Sniper trades tempo for one decisive shot: spend a turn lining it up, then fire once for the damage of two.

Building Focus (from 【Sniper Focus】)

  • 【🛡️Guard】 and give up its Resistances: gain 1 Focus. You can still Cover an ally while you aim.
  • While Hidden, any turn in which you deal no damage: gain 1 Focus. Heal, buff or set up with your other classes while you aim.

Spending Focus

  • You hold up to 1 Focus (2 with 【Perfect Sniping】). You lose all Focus at the end of the conflict.
  • On an 【⚔️Attack】 with a firearm weapon, spend it all: the damage is doubled (tripled with 2 Focus), plus 【SL × 5】.

Staying Unseen

  • 【Camouflage】 makes you Hidden. Dealing damage ends it, except with 【Phantom Snipe】, your quiet shot.
  • The loop: 【Camouflage】 (gain Focus) → Focused shot (revealed) → 【🛡️Guard】 or 【Camouflage】 again.

props.class_lore:
Snipers are silent executioners—those who trade the chaos of close combat for the deadly certainty of a single, well-placed shot. With a steady hand and a sharp eye, they wait patiently in the shadows, calculating every angle and heartbeat before they pull the trigger.

In some cultures, Snipers are seen as ghost-like legends—hunters of men who disappear before the sound of the shot catches up to the kill. In war, they are whispered about in fear. In peace, they are rarely seen at all.
